contextual_identifiers.always: Machine eventless transition trigger (contextual before a transition source).
contextual_identifiers.capture: Private capture prefix capture(var name, ...) before closure or actor literal pipe parameters; an ordinary identifier outside that prefix.
contextual_identifiers.clone: Prefix clone operator (clone <operand>) and independent-copy capability in fn[clone]; an ordinary identifier otherwise (x.clone(), fn clone(...)).
contextual_identifiers.completion: Machine completion transition trigger (contextual after on).
contextual_identifiers.consume: By-move parameter modifier (fn f(consume x: T)) when leading a parameter declaration; an ordinary identifier otherwise (fn f(consume: T), x.consume()).
contextual_identifiers.count: Supervisor pool arity clause (pool ws: Worker { .. } count: N)
contextual_identifiers.default: Machine fallback transition marker (contextual inside a machine body)
contextual_identifiers.description: Identifiers that have special meaning in specific parser contexts but are NOT reserved keywords (they can be used as regular identifiers elsewhere).
contextual_identifiers.drop_new: Overflow policy: discard incoming work and return MessageLost
contextual_identifiers.drop_old: Overflow policy: evict queued work and return MessageLost
contextual_identifiers.emit: Machine event emission marker (contextual before an event name)
contextual_identifiers.emits: Machine Mealy-output manifest block header (contextual inside machine body)
contextual_identifiers.error: Explicit error return: return error expression; an ordinary identifier elsewhere.
contextual_identifiers.events: Machine input-event vocabulary block header (contextual inside machine body)
contextual_identifiers.fail: Overflow policy: reject the send with Full
contextual_identifiers.fails: Function return clause: -> Success fails Error; the call returns Result<Success, Error>.
contextual_identifiers.final: Machine final-state declaration modifier (contextual before state).
contextual_identifiers.handle: Expression-local Result recovery: operand handle error { block }; an ordinary identifier elsewhere.
contextual_identifiers.history: Machine shallow-history destination modifier (contextual after the target state).
contextual_identifiers.initial: Machine initial child declaration or constructor (contextual inside a compound or region).
contextual_identifiers.linear: Type-decl ownership attribute — must be consumed exactly once
contextual_identifiers.once: Consuming invocation capability inside written function type qualifiers: fn[once](...) -> T.
contextual_identifiers.opaque: Type-decl attribute — pointer-width opaque runtime handle (empty-body struct only)
contextual_identifiers.parallel: Machine parallel-state declaration modifier (contextual before state).
contextual_identifiers.pool: Supervisor child-pool declaration marker (contextual inside a supervisor body)
contextual_identifiers.reenter: Machine transition self-re-entry modifier (contextual after target state name)
contextual_identifiers.region: Machine region declaration (contextual inside a parallel state).
contextual_identifiers.resource: Type-decl ownership attribute — move-only, non-duplicable value
contextual_identifiers.self: Selects the imported module itself inside a dotted import selection (import path.{self as alias}).
contextual_identifiers.suspends: Suspending invocation effect inside written function type qualifiers: fn[suspends](...) -> T; an ordinary identifier elsewhere.
contextual_identifiers.wire: Type-decl attribute — marks a type/enum for wire (CBOR/JSON) serialization
contextual_identifiers.within: Scope deadline (scope within duration { ... }) and supervisor intensity window separator

description: Canonical syntax data exported from the Hew compiler. Used by tree-sitter-hew, vscode-hew, hew.sh, and hew.run to generate syntax highlighting grammars.
